about.description: I'm Angel Luis Litago Falces, a web / full-stack developer with experience in FileMaker, IT support and process automation. I build internal tools, integrations and applications that help organize data, reduce manual work and improve real workflows. I combine web development with systems, databases and operational knowledge to create useful, maintainable solutions for day-to-day work.
